interface_findings: Syntax defines distinct ordered gate wires, disjoint-support layers, chronological order, and most-significant-first bit encoding; empty register/circuit conventions are explicit.

Local embedding uses P_w inverse (U tensor I) P_w for distinct selected wires and sorted complement; its basis proof supplies full-register action and uniqueness. Disjoint supports commute by equal basis coefficients. Denotation is U_Ld ... U_L1, unitary with order-independent disjoint layers.

Elementary resources counts explicit gate occurrences/layers/all wires; controlled and inverse access require declarations. One-qubit definition preserves exact phases; controlled block diag(I,U) proof and inverse-order proof do not silently grant query capability.

XOR oracle is total on the full encoded bit domain; its involutive basis permutation is locally proved. Reversible embedding uses fresh work, handles repeated controls with scratch, copies outputs and reverses computation; cost proof and ancilla lemma supply coherent/reference extension and exact work restoration.

Cost model uses minimum shared-wire-respecting layering whereas elementary resources counts declared layers. These are distinct named conventions; HSP theorem claims only additive gate/query/output costs, so it does not equate these depths or claim width additivity.
Measurement page now has actual body and projective-measurement interface. Projective definition gives tr(rho P); HSP proof computes this directly, without importing an absent measurement-law proof.

HSP input fixes invariant factors, injective output labels, invalid-code extension and implicit common-kernel output. Sample circuit explicitly uses exact supplied preparation and full-b-register QFT extension, one oracle evaluation, partial trace, and full computational-basis measurement.

Coset lemma retains equal output indices under partial trace, exactly common cosets by hiding promise; h/N weights normalize. Coset Fourier supplier gives normalized amplitude |Hperp|^-1/2 times conjugate character; sample-law computes uniform supported weights and zero invalid-code weight.

Cut proof detects an element outside H through double annihilator, bounds a nontrivial evaluation kernel by half, and halves K. Repetition coupling thins conditional p>=1/2 cuts to independent Bernoulli(1/2); Chernoff gives exp(-M/16)<=delta. Success theorem consumes this without subgroup-generator extraction.

Cost proof counts M single queries, additive supplied circuit gates, b<=2 log2(N), and separate measurement/discard/classical costs. Examples compute kernels in Z/2 x Z/6 and annihilator {0,4,8} in Z/12 correctly. Exact supplied-circuit hypotheses are retained; no arbitrary-alphabet efficient QFT claim is inferred.

Uniform-family code gives unary input/total width, exact gate count, prefix-delimited indices, ordered distinct output indices and rejects malformed/trailing fields. Its H/T/Tdagger/CNOT labels match actual Clifford-T matrices and control-first order. Each word has a valid singleton-layer realization under QC09 syntax; no implicit controlled gate or extra wire is introduced. Draft status alone supplies no reason to treat the existing library as absent.

Promise model uses exactly n+a(n) ordered wires, zero-initialized auxiliary wires without asserting clean restoration, the syntax output tuple, a total classical predicate and explicit fixed-machine clock when uniformity/cost is claimed. Empty registers/output tuple are handled. Existing machine/encoding/time suppliers support these declarations; no POVM normalization assessment is included here.

Full-list size bound uses one written symbol/head step and strict final contiguous binary-word output (confirmed in def-halting-computation-and-divergence); description length <=n+T+1 bounds gates and unary width. No indexed-list conversion is inferred.

Amplification CNOT fanout copies computational-basis inputs only. Each block then acts on disjoint full wires with identity elsewhere; product-basis coefficient multiplication and finite distributivity yield independent terminal output strings. The concatenated output tuples remain ordered/distinct. No intermediate measurement is needed.

Rational repetition uses r=2s^2(ell(v)+1), polynomial as v has polynomial bit length; the published Chernoff supplier includes the required additive two-sided bound. Comparison 2SBD >= r(AD+CB) implements the midpoint predicate exactly; binary additions/multiplications on polynomial-length operands and polynomially many list records admit polynomial one-tape execution even with polynomial sweeping overhead. No unit-cost arithmetic bound is asserted.

Phase witness uses H then T^4 on control then H, giving HZH=X versus H^2=I; unconditional phase cancels in every squared modulus. Off-promise identity example, n=0 auxiliary-output branch, and explicit quadratic-sweep list generator match actual syntax.
